title: Require Artifact Directory Aggregate Shape
forbids: artifact source directories outside the positive artifact blueprint topology
why: Every artifact directory owns one index and one or more artifact modules. Closing the physical directory shape makes membership auditable while the typed defineArtifactCatalog API owns registered module compatibility without a second source parser. Shared domain vocabulary belongs to the owning domain model rather than creating a second file kind beside artifacts.
remediate: Keep only index.ts and one or more *.artifact.ts modules in each artifacts directory. Inline artifact-private schemas. Move genuinely shared domain schema primitives to the owning domain's model/schemas surface and import them from artifact owners.
message: Artifact directories must match the positive artifact blueprint source topology.
